task: Welcome to another exciting round of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First thing I need you to do is to travel north. Then, open the portal in the workshop. And then, take a trip north. And then, make it so that the hatch is open. And then, take a trip east. With that done, ensure that the passageway in the study is open. Then, make an effort to venture east. Then, travel east. And then, ensure that the safe within the attic is open. Then, retrieve the passkey from the safe within the attic. And if you do that, you're the winner!
